name: Naisho no Houkago
source:
Main character is an ordinary boy, but with a girlish face. He has secret relations with his cousin for a while. With time he starts to show awareness of other girls and get interested in them as the opposite sex... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是个普通男孩，却长着一张女气的脸。他与表妹维持秘密关系已有一段时间。随着时间过去，他开始意识到其他少女的存在，并对她们作为异性产生兴趣……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
